title: First Apply falsely reports failure while the new-source worker already owns the operation
reproduction: https://github.com/stevesolun/AdAway/issues/16 - on signed 13.5.7b API34 VPN save a named Hebrew URL after defaults load and tap configuration Apply before its immediate worker releases the lease
expected: Report contention without claiming failure or acknowledging pending changes; let the existing worker finish
observed: Generic failure while Hebrew returned HTTP 200 and three defaults 304; same worker finished with 182 hosts and one skipped without retry
fix: Represent a rejected lease as BUSY; show existing wait-and-retry text without error icon; preserve target and true failure handling
test_evidence: app/build/reports/audit-2026-11-25/deep-apply/: 05-first-apply.png + signed-timeline.txt + 08-source.txt; identical final instrumented test failed on baseline 3837d195 in red-real-import.txt and passed on patched debug in green-suite.txt (11/11); negative-control 404 is separate. Related PB-RES-010 concerns string wording only. Historic first run lacks logs; this verifies only the reproduced collision variant.

title: Add custom source sheet can call a detached fragment and terminate the app
reproduction: Open the add sheet then replace its owning tab and deliver a late Add custom source click; live crash also observed following Discover/Sources navigation
expected: Open the editor from a current owner or dismiss an obsolete sheet without terminating the app
observed: FATAL EXCEPTION main: startSourceEdition called requireContext on a detached HostsSourcesFragment before the editor opened
fix: Own one sheet per Sources view; clear and dismiss on view destruction; dispatch an option once only from the current resumed and visible sheet
test_evidence: app/build/reports/audit-2026-11-25/deep-apply/: picker-detached-crash.txt at 19:47:24.800 + 22-real-editor.png + 23-editor.txt; deterministic sheet-red.txt reproduced the same exception on 5a1a0d3b; sheet-green-and-apply.txt verifies both late options do nothing and a fresh sheet opens the editor on a649e806. Same instrumentation APK ca6265d7. Not AUD-SRC-001 which concerns SchedulesActivity.
